text: Private browsing (incognito) mode hides your activity only from other people using the same computer.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: If you use private browsing on a work computer, who would NOT be able to see your activity? (the group that runs the company network / your internet provider / a coworker who uses the same computer / the websites you visit / not sure)
room.note: VERIFY: 24% correct and 49% not sure are confirmed by several sources. The wrong-option shares (4% network, 3% ISP, 18% websites → 25) and ~1% no answer come from one search summary; check item KNOW8 in the topline PDF. Multiple choice; 2019 survey, older data.

truthSource.label: Federal Trade Commission, consumer advice on online tracking
truthSource.oneLine: Private or incognito mode only stops your browser from saving history on your device; your network, internet provider and the sites you visit can still see your activity.
